instruction: Use the opened OpenStudio application and its CLI/API automation interface to organize /home/user/Desktop/init.osm and save the updated model as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process OSM text outside the OpenStudio environment. The current model is a two-story research office suite. Each floor is composed of south research areas and north office areas, and the plan stacks vertically. The research team wants to preserve the clear room grid and floor relationships while improving daylight control, ventilation assumptions, and operating loads for the south research areas. Complete the two-story model without breaking the exterior outline, floor stacking, or main partition relationships. Deliver only the updated OpenStudio model file; object handles, serialization order, and automatically generated metadata may vary naturally.
